text:
jess: Heads-up — last night we had two orgs send huge single-request spikes (large batch inference jobs) that emptied the org leaky bucket and then cascaded into p95 latency increases across shared pools. Need a short-term vs steady-state strategy.

kai: Ugh. Are those single huge requests that could be chunked?

jess: Some can be chunked but many are 1-shot rerank/embedding batches from customers. The leaky refill rate is tuned for steady-state qps, so the short spike causes blocking for other keys in the org.

adarsh: Proposal: keep per-key instantaneous "credit" reserves (small token pool) for momentary spikes and keep the org-level leaky bucket as the long-term drain. That separates short-term burst from steady budget.

kai: I like that. How do we avoid the common-pool being gamed? e.g., 100 keys in same org all taking instant credits simultaneously.

adarsh: Two pieces: 1) cap per-key reserve proportional to key weight (weight = historical qps or billing tier) and 2) a fast-decaying penalty multiplier on subsequent immediate claims within a rolling window.

lia: From console/telemetry perspective we need to surface: "credit_used", "credit_denied", "credit_replenish_rate", and a per-request "credit_source" tag (reserve|org|fallback). Can we add those as structured events?

jess: Yes — event names: quota.credit_claim, quota.credit_result, quota.refill_event. Include fields: org_id, key_id, claim_amount, remaining_reserve, source. Add a boolean "preempted_by_higher_priority" for priority preemption.

sre-bot: alert: org/12345 spike -> 4% error increase, p95 latency +340ms, referenced at 2025-11-12T02:12:43Z

nate-pd: For rollout UX: product wants customers to see a simple explanation in Console "Short bursts protected to preserve latency for others" with a link to fine-grained controls. Also expose a slider for per-key reserve size with recommended defaults.

kai: Implementation sketch (runtime): token_reserve per key, org_leaky_bucket per org. Request flow: check token_reserve -> if enough, consume and fast-path. Else, try borrow from org_leaky_bucket (leaky check). Else, apply backpressure/429 or enqueue depending on route.

adarsh: Sample config snippet we can wire into our internal quota API:
```
quota_policy:
  per_key_reserve:
    default_tokens: 50
    max_tokens: 200
    decay_ms: 30000   # reserve ages out in 30s
  org_leaky:
    capacity: 20000
    refill_per_sec: 1000
    leak_window_ms: 60000
  fairness:
    per_org_weighting: true
    rapid_repeat_penalty: 0.5  # subsequent claims within 10s are cheaper
```

lia: Helpful. For telemetry queries, propose PromQL examples to put on dashboards: 
- quota:sum{event="credit_claim",result="granted"} by (org_id)
- rate(quota_metric{event="credit_denied"}[5m]) / rate(requests[5m]) -> fraction denied
- histogram of latency by credit_source

jess: Rollout plan: feature-flag behind "token-reserve-v2". Canary 5% of orgs for 24h, monitor: credit_denied_rate, p95 latency, error rate. If any of those exceed baseline by configured delta (p95 +200ms OR error_rate +0.5%), disable for canary.

nate-pd: And product message for Console when canary is on: put a notice and an opt-out for enterprise customers.

kai: One more operational concern: billing. If reserve lets short spikes through, customers may be surprised by burst invoices. Add an opt-in "allow-burst-billing" flag default=false and surface bursts in monthly usage breakdown.

adarsh: Agree. Also export per-reserve-claim cost_estimate event so billing can aggregate.

lia: I'll add the telemetry fields and dashboard tiles: "reserve consumption heatmap" and "reserve denials by org tier". Also add a log sample field so support can repro quickly.

jess: Good next steps: (1) eng-platform spike-handling PR with config above, (2) eng-runtime implement fast-path reserve, (3) obs add telemetry events and dashboard mocks, (4) product copy for console and billing opt-in. I'll file the cards.

nate-pd: Thanks — please ping me when we have a mock for the Console slider. :thumbsup:

kai: I'll take runtime PR.

adarsh: I'll drive fairness heuristics + tests.

lia: I'll add telemetry and a Grafana dashboard draft.

sre-bot: deploy-bot: canary toggled for token-reserve-v2 -> 5% orgs (start 2025-11-12T03:00:00Z)

jess: Great — keeping an eye on it.

(threads end)
